question: Is the E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial Atari Landfill story an urban legend?

reasoning.gold: An urban legend is a humorous or horrifying story based on hearsay that is circulated as true. E.T. the Extra Terrestrial was panned as one of the worst video games ever made. A widespread story stated that thousands of copies of E.T. the Extra Terrestrial video game were buried in a landfill A former Atari manager stated that 728,000 Atari games were in fact buried in a landfill. The Atari landfill was dug up and nearly 900 games were recovered, but there was only one copy of E.T. included.
